reviews.title: Price
reviews.text: Driver are rude always trying to change the price app would say one thing but the drivers app would say something else. Dispatcher does not take complaints seriously. Drivers refuse to pick up at pickup address they want you to cross in middle of streets. Walk to corners when asked to pick up at location they get an attitude and drive off very unprofessional.
